label: Fix: claim-verification worker timeout, dual-handler comment, unused VerifierBusyError
summary: Applied three fixes to libs/data/verify/claim-verification: (1) configurable timeout in WorkerProxy.send() defaulting to 30s (spec §D8); (2) explanatory comment on the dual message-handler pattern in start(); (3) removed unused VerifierBusyError re-export from index.ts.

changes.kind: added timeout guard to send() method + configurable timeoutMs param (default 30s)
added comment explaining dual-handler pattern (warmupPromise vs general message handler)
removed VerifierBusyError from re-export (class exists but never used)

handoff_notes: VerifierBusyError class retained in errors.ts for API compatibility (external consumers may import it); only the re-export from index.ts was removed.
maxQueueDepth in ClaimVerifierConfig (types.ts) is not referenced in ClaimVerifierImpl — no change needed per spec guidance.
The dual-handler pattern in start() is documented with a [inv:no-untracked-injection] invariant marker.
